rows.name: Vald
rows.description: Vald is an advanced, scalable vector search engine, tailored for AI and machine learning applications in the cloud-native ecosystem. Specializing in high-dimensional vector data, it provides efficient and near real-time search capabilities, essential for handling vast datasets in AI research and development. Designed for seamless integration and user-friendliness, Vald supports AI innovators with state-of-the-art search technology.
